Title: Kunal and the Family

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Pallavi - 38 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Sharda - 75 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
4. Aditi - 8 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "Kunal, what's the plan today?"

[Kunal nods.]

Pallavi (softly): "What happened?"

[Kunal shouts angrily.]

Kunal: "Exactly right."

[Kunal gets frightened and steps back.]

Kunal: "And then?"

[Kunal sneezes loudly.]

Pallavi: "Exactly right."

[Snow begins to fall.]

Kunal: "What happened?"

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Pallavi: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
